issues.issue: The design asserts 'the inlining path (:92-97) is already correct: an outer-correlated variable is never assured by filterArg so nothing is inlined'. That is only true when the outer variable is absent from the EXISTS body. When the outer variable is ALSO bound inside the body it IS assured by filterArg and SameTermFilterOptimizer.renameVar (SameTermFilterOptimizer.java:164-173) can rename the OUTER variable away and delete the filter. Counterexample: data `:s1 :p :a . :s1 :q :b . :s1 :r :b .`, query `SELECT ?s { ?s :p ?x FILTER EXISTS { ?s :q ?o . ?s :r ?x FILTER(sameTerm(?o, ?x)) } }`. leftArg=?o, rightArg=?x -> renameVar(oldVar=x, newVar=o): body becomes `?s :q ?o . ?s :r ?o` + Extension(x := ?o); the filter is gone. Expected: EXISTS{ s1 :q ?o . s1 :r a } is false (no :r :a) -> 0 rows. In the STREAMING/ADAPTIVE probe (FilterIterator.java:293-302, default ADAPTIVE) the body runs with input {s=s1,x=a}: SP1 gives o=b, SP2 `s1 :r b` matches, ExtensionIterator.setValue overwrites x (ExtensionIterator.java:79-81) -> a row exists -> EXISTS true -> spurious `s1`. In MATERIALIZED mode the body is evaluated unbound and probed on shared {s,x} -> correct, so the divergence is executor-mode dependent. Pre-existing on develop (file identical), all stores. bindVar (constant case) is safe because the Filter is retained and StatementConvertor preserves an existing input binding (StatementConvertor.java:98-102), so `?s :q [x=v1]` plus the kept filter still enforces x==v1.
issues.suggestion: Extend the fix: while outerVisible is non-empty, (a) never renameVar away a variable that is outer-visible; if exactly one of the two Vars is outer-visible rename the inner one INTO the outer one (`sameTerm(?x,?o)` direction is sound: body `?s :q ?x . ?s :r ?x` + Extension(o := ?x)); if both are outer-visible skip inlining; (b) keep bindVar as is. Add the counterexample above as a MemoryStore test and, per 3.11.6, run it under the streaming-correlated and materialized-hash hints since only the streaming path is wrong.

issues.issue: The '(latent)' BSA-guard item is not latent: it is a branch regression (BR, S1) with a concrete wrong result. On this branch BindingSetAssignment.getAssuredBindingNames() drops names that are UNDEF in any row (BindingSetAssignment.java:82-99), whereas develop returns all declared names (develop BindingSetAssignment.java:43-49). SameTermFilterOptimizer.java:118 guards with `bsa.getAssuredBindingNames()`, and VarRenamer only rewrites Var nodes (SameTermFilterOptimizer.java:233-250), never BSA rows. Counterexample: data `:s1 :p :w . :s1 :q :w .`, query `SELECT ?s ?x ?y { VALUES ?y { UNDEF :v } ?s :p ?x . ?s :q ?y FILTER(sameTerm(?x, ?y)) }`. Expected 1 row (y=UNDEF row -> x=w,y=w; y=:v row -> s1 :q :v absent). After renameVar(y->x) the patterns become `?s :p ?x . ?s :q ?x` + Extension(y := ?x) while the BSA still holds {y=:v}: the y=:v input row now also matches (s1 :q w) and Extension overwrites y -> 2 rows (duplicate), or a wrong y=:v if the Extension did not overwrite. Also, the design assigns repro `sameTermWithUndefValuesColumn` to 3.11.2 only, but SameTermFilterOptimizer runs BEFORE FilterOptimizer in both pipelines (StandardQueryOptimizerPipeline.java:79 vs :86; LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.java:255 vs :259), so that repro is reached by this guard first (bindVar keeps the filter, so either fix alone turns it green; the two-var variant above is only fixed by this guard).
issues.suggestion: Promote the BSA guard change (`bsa.getBindingNames()`, possible names may only block) from '(latent)' to a fix-now item with its own red test (the two-var VALUES/UNDEF query above) and label it BR not PRE. Note in the test plan that `sameTermWithUndefValuesColumn` is covered by both 3.11.2 and this guard.

issues.issue: The identity-memo fix restores `p == n` within one optimize() pass but ignores the plan cache, and the design lists cold-vs-warm behaviour nowhere. LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.java:100-117: the cache key is taken from the un-optimized tree, `computePlan` runs the request-bound optimizers (ConstantOptimizer folds both NOW() into ValueConstants holding sharedValueOfNow, ConstantOptimizer.java:258-300) and the fully optimized tree is what gets cached; on a hit `use.plan().materialize()` is `template.clone()` (LmdbPlanDecisionCache.java:576-578) and the request-bound optimizers are NOT re-run. LmdbPipelinePlanCache.ReusableInputVisitor (:662-679) only refuses Service and non-Collection VALUES, and neither the cache identity nor the LMDB module references Now/getNow (rg over PackedQueryCacheIdentity and core/sail/lmdb main: no hits). By code reading, a second execution of any NOW() query on LmdbStore returns the timestamp of the first execution for the cache lifetime. The compliance test runs SES869 once, so [20] can go green while warm-cache NOW() is wrong (S1, PRE on branch, LMDB only). Not run; PLAUSIBLE.
issues.suggestion: Before landing the memo, run `SELECT (NOW() AS ?n) {}` twice on LmdbStore with the plan cache enabled and compare. Fix candidates (plan-cache owner): make ReusableInputVisitor return false when any FunctionCall resolves to Now (or any ScalarEvaluationEffects QUERY_STABLE/VOLATILE expression), or keep NOW() unfolded in the cached template and substitute per request. Keep the identity memo as the [20] fix but document that it does not cover reuse.

issues.issue: The root-cause text is factually wrong on two points that the triage plan depends on. (1) `testCustomFunction_MultipleSumWithDistinctGroupBy` (CustomAggregateFunctionEvaluationTest.java:404-421) DOES have `order by ?s`, so if it is among the 4 failing methods the 'implementation-defined order, no ORDER BY' hypothesis is dead and a value defect must be assumed. (2) 'the only methods that use group by are exactly the *WithDistinct methods' is false: testCustomFunction_MultipleSumWithHaving (:426), testSumWithHavingFilter (:441), testAvgWithHavingFilter (:456) and testNonExistentCustomAggregateFunction3 (:497) also group. The raw notes only say '*WithDistinct (4)' of 5, so which four fail is unknown. Verified as correct: GroupIterator differs from develop only by constructor plumbing (git diff origin/develop: 16 lines, no DistinctValues change), createGroupByMap is LinkedHashMap (DefaultCollectionFactory.java:97) and createValueSet is HashSet (:60). Note however DefaultCollectionFactory differs from develop by +110 lines (createSetOfBindingSets -> BindingSetHashSet), so 'collection code unchanged' should not be claimed.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite the triage: step 0 = identify the four failing method names from the compliance report; if MultipleSumWithDistinctGroupBy is among them go straight to Routine A on the DISTINCT value path; only if the four are exactly the ORDER-BY-less ones proceed with the order-only diff. Drop the 'only group-by tests' claim.

issues.issue: Denylist blast radius under-enumerated: spif:currentTimeMillis (core/spin/.../spif/CurrentTimeMillis.java) is a zero-arg clock function that does not declare mustReturnDifferentResult() (rg shows only Random, GenerateUUID, RAND, UUID, STRUUID declare it), and SpinFunction / AskFunction / EvalFunction bodies are user SPARQL that may call RAND()/NOW(). Under the denylist these become REPEATABLE, i.e. learnable by LMDB FilterSurfaceKey/SemiAntiSurfaceKey and recordable by FilterIterator.shouldRecordFilterOutcomes (FilterIterator.java:780-786). Within one query this is no worse than today because ConstantOptimizer already folds zero-arg non-volatile functions (ConstantOptimizer.java:258-300), but cross-query learning keys are a new exposure the design does not mention.
issues.suggestion: Add CurrentTimeMillis to the spin follow-up (mustReturnDifferentResult -> true, or a new query-stable marker), and consider treating any spin `AbstractSpinFunction` subclass as UNKNOWN for learning keys (REPEATABLE only for placement) until the SPIN body is audited. State explicitly in the design that REPEATABLE now also means 'stable across queries for learning'.

issues.issue: crossWpTouchpoints claims 'FilterOptimizer runs after join ordering in both pipelines'. False for LMDB: LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.java:259 runs FilterOptimizer(null,false,false) inside requestBoundOptimizerList, and the cascades planner runs afterwards at :116-117. So on LMDB the packed planner consumes filters already placed by FilterOptimizer and then PackedFilterRules/lattice re-place them; the fix is still correct but the 'does not reverse any join-order decision' statement does not hold there, and the c3 packed repro (PackedRuleSemanticsReviewReproTest.java:142-215) feeds the parsed tree directly to PackedCascadesPlanner, bypassing FilterOptimizer, so it exercises PackedFilterRules alone as intended.
issues.suggestion: Correct the statement; for LMDB end-to-end tests of the three f8 queries, assert on results not plan shape, since two independent placers are involved.

issues.issue: The ancestor-walk inherits an oddity: Filter.getBindingNames() (Filter.java:59-68) adds the EXISTS sub-query's binding names when the condition is directly an Exists. For outerVisibleNames this is a harmless superset, but the same method feeds the possible-name preconditions in 3.11.1 (QueryModelNormalizerOptimizer.java:133) and 3.11.2 (`target.getBindingNames()`/`sibling.getBindingNames()`), where it can only block or (in 3.11.1) satisfy a precondition that isPlainJoinAlgebra then rejects for direct Exists (:159) — an `And(…, Exists)` condition passes :159 but the new per-Filter assured check covers it. Verified sound, but the design should say it relies on this.
issues.suggestion: Add a one-line note that Filter.getBindingNames() over-approximates with EXISTS body names and that all three guards only use it as a blocker (never as permission).

issues.issue: The design's own inlining blind spot (first issue) is executor-mode dependent: wrong under STREAMING/MEMOIZED probes, correct under MATERIALIZED (unbound body + probe on shared {s,x}). This is exactly the class the mode sweep is meant to catch, but the sweep seeds list only f5/f8 shapes.
issues.suggestion: Add `?s :p ?x FILTER EXISTS { ?s :q ?o . ?s :r ?x FILTER(sameTerm(?o,?x)) }` (and its `sameTerm(?x,?o)` mirror) to the mode-sweep seed set and to the NoREC generator grammar (sameTerm with an outer-correlated var inside EXISTS).

missedFindings: SameTermFilterOptimizer.renameVar renames an outer-visible EXISTS/LATERAL variable away (SameTermFilterOptimizer.java:164-173), dropping the sameTerm constraint; pre-existing, all stores, mode dependent (wrong in streaming probes). The design explicitly claims this path is correct.

SameTermFilterOptimizer.java:118 BSA guard on getAssuredBindingNames() is a branch regression (UNDEF rows revoke assurance on this branch, BindingSetAssignment.java:82-99; develop :43-49 returns all names) producing duplicate/wrong rows for `VALUES ?y {UNDEF :v} … FILTER(sameTerm(?x,?y))`; the design lists it only as '(latent)'.

LMDB plan cache serves NOW() folded at first execution on every cache hit (LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.java:100-117, LmdbPlanDecisionCache.java:576-578, LmdbPipelinePlanCache.java:662-679 refuses only Service / non-Collection VALUES); adjacent to the builtinFunction()[20] fix, not covered by it (by code reading).

3.11.3: after the denylist, filters over spif:currentTimeMillis() or SPIN-defined functions calling RAND() are relocated/split/merged and become learnable LMDB filter surfaces; within-query results are unchanged (ConstantOptimizer already folds zero-arg calls) but learned selectivities may be poisoned across queries.

3.11.1: the new per-Filter assured check correctly still allows `VALUES ?x {:a :b} { ?x :p ?o BIND(1 AS ?one) }` (SP assures x); it declines any group whose Filter mentions a pushed name over an unassured arg, so LMDB theme plans with `VALUES … { … OPTIONAL/VALUES-UNDEF … FILTER(?x …) BIND }` lose the hash-join avoidance — correctness-motivated, benchmark check recommended as the design says.

3.2.5 packed: with the intersection rule, Join(LeftJoin(SP_p,SP_q),SP_r)+FILTER(?x=?y) now yields leftContains=false and rightContains=false -> rule returns 1 (PackedFilterRules.java:94-96), filter stays at the join in fallback mode; only budget-exhausted or >16-factor regions change.

3.11.2: strictly fewer pushes. The LMDB null-rejecting rewrite (LmdbNullRejectingOptionalSupport.java:61-66 and LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer.makeOptionalBindingMandatory :519-526) only matches Filter directly over LeftJoin, so it still fires for the sound shape `?s :p ?y OPTIONAL{?s :q ?x} ?s :r ?z FILTER(?x=?y)` (x only from the optional -> filter still descends into the LeftJoin) and stops firing for the unsound f8 shape; no sound optimization lost.
3.11.4: EmptySet is no longer produced inside EXISTS bodies for a variable bound nowhere (neither inner nor outer); the filter is evaluated at runtime instead — sound, tiny cost.
